seo.title: Careers — join a team building systems measured by the global standard | Awalim Group
seo.description: Engineering and design roles at Awalim Group: fully remote, real code review, and standards we don't trade away. Apply with a project, not a CV.

h: Build the systems that run companies, with us
lede: We hire to the standard we ship to: balanced entries, tests that block regressions, and Arabic from the root. We ask less for years of experience than for something you built that we can read.

items.d: Everything you write is reviewed line by line — and everything we write is reviewed by you. That is how all of us learn.
The team has been distributed since day one. We measure output, not hours online, and we meet on a published schedule rather than by interruption.
You are not building a slide. You are building a system an accountant in Saudi Arabia or a family in Gaza will use tomorrow.
Written expectations for every level, and a review every six months against criteria known in advance — no surprises.

steps.d: Send something you built — a repository, a published app, or a design file — and two lines about a hard decision you made in it.
We talk about that project specifically: why that decision, and what you would change about it today.
A task from our real work, with a sensible time limit, and paid. We do not ask for free labour.
We answer yes or no with a written reason. If it is no, we say precisely what was missing.

roles.title: Senior backend engineer
roles.summary: You build the heart of Smart Accountant: the ledger engine, posting, and multi-tenant isolation on three layers. Precision here is not a feature — it is the condition.
does: Designing data schemas and migrations that can be reviewed and reverted
Writing accounting logic where no unbalanced entry passes
Building multi-tenant isolation at the route, storage and row level
Reviewing your colleagues' code, and accepting theirs on yours
needs: PostgreSQL in depth: transactions, isolation levels, indexing and query plans
TypeScript on the server with schema validation on every request
Automated tests you write before the feature, not after
The ability to explain an architectural decision in writing
bonus: An accounting background or ERP experience
Drizzle or any ORM that emits exported migrations

roles.title: Flutter engineer
roles.summary: You build apps used daily in environments where the network really does drop — RahmaCare, Jameel Store and what comes next.
does: Turning Figma files into pixel-accurate interfaces with full Arabic support
Building local storage and sync when the network returns
Watching the frame and bundle budget on every release
Publishing to both stores and handling the review
needs: Flutter with clean state management (Riverpod or Bloc) that survives growth
A working understanding of right-to-left — not just flipping a flag
An eye for detail: motion curves, scroll bounce and touch timing
bonus: Having shipped an app to both stores yourself

roles.title: Applied AI engineer
roles.summary: You build agents that carry out real tasks inside client systems — with written permission boundaries and measured evaluation before every launch.
does: Defining the task, the permission boundary and the tool design
Building knowledge systems that cite the source in every answer
Building evaluation sets from real data and measuring accuracy before release
Designing human stopping points at every financial or legal effect
needs: Hands-on experience building agents or RAG systems that reached real users
Python or TypeScript, and the ability to measure what you build rather than describe it
An understanding of cost and latency as engineering constraints
Healthy scepticism: you know when a task does not need an agent at all
bonus: A published evaluation or model comparison

roles.title: Product designer (Arabic-first)
roles.summary: You design Arabic interfaces that are measured, not estimated: measured contrast, tuned typography, and design tokens that reach the code.
does: Designing systems rather than screens: tokens, components and states
Tuning Arabic typography — spacing, joining and diacritics
Measuring contrast and accessibility before handover, not after
Working inside the repository: you read the code and push CSS changes yourself
needs: A portfolio with at least one Arabic design system in it
Figma with components and variables, not scattered frames
Reading HTML/CSS with confidence — even if you never write JavaScript

roles.title: Academy mentor (part time)
roles.level: 3+ years in one of our tracks
roles.summary: You review trainees' code and write notes they resubmit against — not a model answer.
does: Reviewing weekly submissions with written notes
One weekly session discussing an architectural decision
Proposing curriculum improvements from what you see repeat
needs: Real production experience in the track you mentor
The ability to explain «why», not only «how»

spontaneous.d: We read every message. Send a project you built and two lines about the role you want, and we will reply even if the answer is «not now».

equal: We hire on skill and standard alone. Our seats are open regardless of gender, age, geography or background — and we especially encourage women engineers and designers to apply.
